_doc: Species field-note details (Bokidex quirks-v1, owner 11-09). Keys are Bokidex ids: a game species' display name in lower case (BokiQuirks.key). 'quirk' and 'sexNote' are copied verbatim from bokidex/work/quirks-v1.json; the sections after them make a few of those notes real on the farm.

quirk.vespyx: Hunts at dusk and buries spare prey in shallow scrapes, then forgets half of them.
quirk.vespox: Wipes its sting on bark every dawn; the scratched trees mark its patrol route.
quirk.glaivyx: Sleeps standing with the scythe tail raised; nothing wild roosts within a stone's throw.
quirk.prismander: Keep it by a window: its crystal frills grow faster in direct sunlight.
quirk.glassolotl: Chirps whenever a rainbow shows, often minutes before anyone else spots it.
quirk.chandelotl: Its gill crown dims when it sulks and blazes after a bite of sugar cane.
quirk.mycroll: Rolls through compost after rain; a happy one leaves glowing footprints at night.
quirk.sporcupine: Drops a few quills each wet morning; dried, they season stews with a smoky taste.
quirk.amanitusk: Scratches red warning rings into bark around its ground; farm Boki stay outside them.
quirk.gravadillo: Sleeps upside down on the barn ceiling, held there by its own pull.
quirk.mothlet: Falls asleep leaning on lanterns and wakes dusted in moth powder.
quirk.lunowl: Hunts only on clear nights; on cloudy ones it dozes and eats from your hand.
quirk.eclipsowl: Casts a dim ring of shade wherever it perches; crops beneath grow slowly.
quirk.echolop: Thumps a hind foot twice before anyone else hears a visitor coming.
quirk.howlop: Its night howl carries for miles; neighbouring farms treat it as a storm warning.
quirk.rampartoad: Will not move until it has sat at least an hour; shift it and it croaks.
quirk.zipling: Zips itself into any pocket you leave open and naps there.
quirk.zippelith: Leaves a thin seam across the field where it dives; follow it to its stash.
quirk.seamwyrm: Surfaces at midnight, always at the exact spot it dived three days earlier.
quirk.anchorbill: Hoards anything iron and drops it from height just to hear it ring.
quirk.bellowlet: Squeaks its chest in time with your footsteps when it wants carrying.
quirk.bellowary: Needs a hard run every morning or the bellows wheeze all day.
quirk.furnacowary: Eats charcoal by the sack; its chest glow tells you when it is hungry.
quirk.wickapi: Its single wick will not light while it is afraid; a calm one burns all night.
quirk.snuffapi: Lights one extra candle for each person it trusts; most never earn a second.
quirk.chandelapi: Only a fully bonded rider is allowed to snuff its candles by hand.
quirk.coolatee: Follows anyone carrying fresh fish and keeps it cold for them.
quirk.frigatee: Refuses to open its drawers in rain; loot stays shut until it dries.
quirk.glaciatee: Hums a different note for each drawer; keepers learn which note holds what.
quirk.gongibbon: Rings its own belly at sunrise; nobody on the farm sleeps late.
quirk.gongrowl: Each dent in its gong crest is a fight it remembers; it will not let you polish them.
quirk.kayak: Paddles across puddles on its back for fun and refuses to come out.
quirk.prowyak: Clears a path to your door after every snowfall without being asked.
quirk.dreadnoyak: Breathes frost on hot days to cool itself; stand downwind for relief.
quirk.glintmole: Pops up a minute before a tremor; other farm Boki learn to follow it out.
quirk.geodemole: Sorts dug-up stones by colour into little piles outside its burrow.
quirk.druzemole: Grows a new amethyst spike every full moon; the old ones can be traded.
quirk.gloamshell: Lanterns burn dimmer wherever it crawls; keep it out of the barn at night.
quirk.glomwort: Creeps toward spilled food overnight; sweep up or wake to a yellow net.
quirk.effigeetle: Will not fly in rain; raindrops on its marble face make it sneeze.
quirk.crofthorn: Herbs planted on its back grow twice as fast as those in the ground.
quirk.skidlet: Only stays upright on ice; on grass it topples and peeps for help.
quirk.skateron: Stands motionless at a pond edge for hours, then strikes exactly once.
quirk.lanceron: Its blade feathers hum in wind; a high whine means a gale tonight.
quirk.ermink: Dips its tail in any ink or mud and scribbles on your walls.
quirk.flarmink: Draws warm strokes on cold mornings; frost melts wherever it writes.
quirk.rippmink: Paints wave lines on the shore that show how high the next tide reaches.
quirk.blossmink: Petals it paints bloom real by morning if left on good soil.
quirk.voltmink: Its strokes crackle; on dry days its fur stands on end and shocks you.
quirk.rimink: Paints frost lace on windows at dawn, never the same pattern twice.
quirk.umbrink: Its ink never dries; whatever it marks stays smudged for days.
quirk.lunink: Only paints under moonlight; by day the silver fades to nothing.
quirk.prismink: Each stroke splits into a rainbow when the sun hits it.
quirk.wyrmink: Coils through the air leaving a trailing ink line that fades in seconds.
quirk.kestrike: Hovers over the same fence post before every storm; the post is your warning.
quirk.arcestrel: Perches on the tallest metal thing you own; put up a lightning rod.
quirk.voltalon: Lightning strikes twice as often near it, and it treats each bolt as a snack.
quirk.tinbrock: Rattles its tin snout against pots when the stove is too cold.
quirk.anvilbrock: Lies on its back in snow and the melt puddle gives away where it slept.
quirk.forgebrock: Hammers any metal left outdoors; dented tools mean it was bored.
quirk.kindlewren: Steals a coal from your fire each evening and sulks if there is none.
quirk.embrook: Sleeps in dead hearths; your fire relights itself if one roosts there.
quirk.pyrraven: Its wings glow brighter as the sun sets; a dim one needs feeding.
quirk.dribbara: Its back puddle only fills in rain; it stands outside until topped up.
quirk.soakybara: Other farm Boki crowd into its spring on cold nights; it never minds.
quirk.geysirbara: Erupts on a schedule to the minute; farmers set their clocks by it.
quirk.buckleron: Clamps down at sunset and will not budge till sunrise, whatever you offer.
quirk.lodestick: Loose nails and coins drift toward it overnight; check it before you search.
quirk.marchleaf: Trims the farm's leaves in neat half-moons; a ragged hedge means it is unhappy.
quirk.scythant: Cuts a clean path through tall grass ahead of you on every walk.
quirk.reapant: Never leaves its nest; its workers carry every meal to it.
quirk.lanterloris: Floats up to the ceiling when startled; coax it down with warm milk.
quirk.mossgrade: Dries to a pebble in a drought; one splash and it is back and hungry.
quirk.spirevark: Its termites repair the spire overnight; a missing turret means it is sick.
quirk.murmurling: Copies the first sound it hears each dawn, usually your door.
quirk.mirrolin: Rolls into the sun on cold mornings and warms the yard with reflections.
quirk.nettlynx: Only lets you stroke it head to tail; the other way stings.
quirk.thistlynx: Sheds thistle fluff in autumn; it drifts into every other Boki's bedding.
quirk.briarlynx: Grows a ring of briar around wherever it sleeps; move it rarely.
quirk.fizzlet: Its static fluff clings to everything; it comes home coated in straw.
quirk.boltstrich: Runs laps at dawn and cannot start the day without a race.
quirk.thunderstrich: A small cloud gathers over its head when cross; clear sky means content.
quirk.bubblisk: Blows bubble copies of other Boki when bored; they pop within seconds.
quirk.frothisk: Leaves foam footprints across the pond; follow them to find it sunning.
quirk.tidalisk: Its foam crest rises and falls with the tide even miles from the sea.
quirk.terrasloth: Opens its greenhouse glass only on humid mornings; that is when the orchids bloom.
quirk.rimeshrew: Eats every hour, day and night; leave food out or it raids the stores.
quirk.teapotamus: Whistles through its spout when full; silence means feed it.
quirk.puffamus: Puffs a smoke ring for each visitor it likes; strangers get nothing.
quirk.chuggamus: Needs coal and water every morning; skip either and it will not start.
quirk.selenfin: Drifts toward whoever hurts most; it finds the sick one before you do.
quirk.barokat: Stands on the highest point of the farm; if it climbs down, get indoors.
quirk.bucketmander: Tips its bucket shell over seedlings on dry days; nobody taught it that.
quirk.barrelmander: Sleeps in the nearest puddle and wakes barking the moment thunder sounds.
quirk.cisternmander: Its tower fills in rain and the whole farm drinks from it in drought.
quirk.kerchick: Its wing cloths catch the breeze and it tumbles over; it loves this.
quirk.jibbatross: Points its wings into the morning wind; a reliable weathervane.
quirk.canvastross: Grows restless after a week inland; take it somewhere it can see water.
quirk.knotwyrm: Sleeps across doorways; the household learns to step over, never on.
quirk.thrumbird: Hums one steady note while you work; tools held nearby shake less.
quirk.lyrewing: Learns any tune played near it by the third hearing.
quirk.latchling: Clicks its latch open and shut when thinking; a long click means yes.
quirk.lockatara: Picks one box to guard and only its tail key will open it.
quirk.vaultara: Lets smaller farm Boki shelter inside its shell during storms.
quirk.parasolth: Opens its rib arms a crack when rain is coming; a good forecast.
quirk.umbrathere: Shelters any small Boki in rain and growls at those who refuse to come under.
quirk.pipewurm: Pipes little icing flowers onto whoever strokes it; sticky but sweet.
quirk.oarlet: Paddles in circles in any bucket left out and squeaks for applause.
quirk.oarter: Rows across the farm pond at sunset, always exactly three laps.
quirk.galleotter: Rams anything floating in the pond and stacks the wreckage on the bank.
quirk.kitlet: Catches updrafts off the roof and hovers there until called down.
quirk.ribbonwyrm: Its streamers point into the wind; sky-fishers watch which way they stream.
quirk.dragonkite: Only flies when the wind is up; on still days it lies on the warm roof.
quirk.jarmit: Swaps jars when it finds a prettier one and leaves the old one at your door.
quirk.lanternmit: Glows as dusk falls and dims when strangers come near.
quirk.stormit: Its bottle crackles louder before a storm; keep it off the wooden shelf.
quirk.terrarimit: The moss in its shell grows a single flower when it is content.
quirk.cairnback: Adds one pebble to its cairn for every expedition it comes home from.
quirk.hivara: Its swarm leaves wax drops wherever honey is stored; follow them.
quirk.zephyrak: Static builds in its scales overnight; it shocks whoever touches it first each morning.

sexNote.hivara: Only female; the swarm is her daughters
sexNote.reapant: Only female; every one is a queen
sexNote.glomwort: No sexes; it splits and spreads
sexNote.mossgrade: Only female; eggs need no mate
sexNote.lodestick: Nearly all female; males are rare
sexNote.cairnback: Cool eggs hatch male, warm hatch female
sexNote.latchling: Warm eggs hatch male, cool hatch female
sexNote.lockatara: Warm eggs hatch male, cool hatch female
sexNote.vaultara: Warm eggs hatch male, cool hatch female
sexNote.bellowlet: Fathers sit the eggs and raise chicks
sexNote.bellowary: Males sit the eggs and raise chicks
sexNote.furnacowary: Males sit the eggs and raise chicks
sexNote.buckleron: Born male, turns female as it grows

female_share._doc: share of hatches that are female (default 0.5); used by BokiQuirks.sex_for

food_rate._doc: multiplier on how fast the food need drains (default 1.0)

rain_joy._doc: joy gained (or lost) per minute at home while it rains

storm_sense._doc: seconds before rain starts that it starts warning about it
